text: Because each sem token carries a different value depending on the post that minted it and on its position in the reference graph, the total value is difficult to determine, which makes it almost impossible to execute a 51% attack by purchasing tokens on an exchange.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Secure Proof of Stake Protocol (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3125827
abstract: their value is difficult to determine since each token has a different value depending on the post in which it was minted. So it is almost impossible to execute a 51% attack by purchasing tokens on an exchange.
